Hi Samir — great to hear. Attaching a draft MAP (FinPlus_MAP_draft_v1.xlsx) and a lightweight SIG/CAIQ mapping PDF. High level answers inline: 

- MAP approach: we split the plan into two parallel tracks: 1) POC (tech): env setup, sample queries, perf targets, success criteria (owner: Naomi). 2) Security/compliance: evidence collection, CAIQ mapping, DPA negotiation, retention clauses (owner: Kimberly). Each row in the spreadsheet has owner, ETA, and acceptance criteria.

- SOC 2: Redwood completed SOC 2 Type II for the period ending 2026-04-30. We can provide the SOC 2 report under NDA; scope includes hosted API, infra controls, and logging. We will list the SOC scope in the MAP today.

- SIG/CAIQ mapping: attached (SIG-CAIQ-mapping-lite.pdf). We highlight ~24 items FinPlus marked as blockers; the mapping indicates which items are satisfied by our SOC 2, which require supplemental evidence (network diagrams, KMS proof, data retention config), and which are configuration choices for the customer.

- Data retention (proposed defaults for MAP/DPA):
  * Auth and system logs: 90 days (configurable; longer retention available by request)
  * Aggregated analytics/usage metadata: 180 days
  * Customer content (user-provided payloads): default 30 days post-inference then purged unless customer requests retention/archival
  * Backups / disaster recovery snapshots: 90 days, encrypted; retention beyond 90 days available under storage addendum
  * Audit trails necessary for investigations: 2 years (redaction available)

Notes: these are our starting points for negotiation. We can add EU residency carve-outs (for your EU customers) and escrow/long-term retention options in the DPA.

Next steps I propose:
- We’ll update the MAP with SOC scope and target due dates by EOD tomorrow (owner: Naomi).
- Kimberly will prepare a DPA retention proposal redline for your legal team by next Wednesday.
- Can we schedule a 30-min sync with your security lead and procurement on Thursday 19th?

Thanks — attaching the files and the Drive link.

--
